DealerStoreSection.title: DealerStoreSection
DealerStoreSection.description: Stores a persistent section of the dealer application state (siteSettings, users, tenors, motorModels, motorVariants, motorColors, motorImages, motorSpecs, creditSimulations, promos, articles, testimonials, uploadsMeta) as native Firestore maps and lists.

sectionKey.description: Unique identifier of the state section.

payload.description: Native Firestore Map containing the structured state data for this section.

syncToken.description: Server synchronization verification token for authorized persistence.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last update.

DealerUploadChunk.title: DealerUploadChunk
DealerUploadChunk.description: Stores a bounded base64 chunk (<= 650KB) of an uploaded image asset so uploaded photos persist permanently in Firestore without exceeding the 1MB document limit.

uploadId.description: Unique ID of the parent uploaded image.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded image (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp).

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded image.

data.description: Base64 encoded payload chunk (strictly bounded <= 700000 chars).

syncToken.description: Server synchronization verification token for authorized persistence.

AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Trusted administrator record for Firebase Auth role verification.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

/dealer_store/{sectionId}.description: Persistent cloud storage for each section of the dealer database state.

/dealer_uploads/{chunkId}.description: Persistent cloud storage for uploaded image chunks.
